title: Christmas Markets in Mitte - FAQ
subtitle: Order, opening hours, entry and the days that break the plan.

items.q: Can you walk between the Christmas markets in Mitte?
items.a: Yes. Alexanderplatz, the Rotes Rathaus, the Humboldt Forum and Gendarmenmarkt are about **3 km** apart end to end, roughly **40 minutes** of walking without stops. On Advent weekends you can add Sophienstraße near Hackescher Markt at the start.

items.q: Which Christmas market in Mitte closes first?
items.a: On weekdays the big four all close at **22:00**. On Advent weekends **Sophienstraße** closes first, at 20:00 on Saturday and 19:00 on Sunday, while **Gendarmenmarkt** stays open until **23:00 on Friday and Saturday**.

items.q: Does the Gendarmenmarkt Christmas market cost money?
items.a: Yes, it is the only one of these that charges: **2 euros**, children under 12 free. Entry is free **Monday to Friday from 11:00 to 14:00**, except on 24, 25, 26 and 31 December.

items.q: Is there a Christmas market at Hackescher Markt in 2026?
items.a: No market on the square is listed for 2026. The nearest is the **Sophienstraße market**, about five minutes on foot from the station, which opens on Advent weekends only.

items.q: Which Mitte Christmas markets are open on 24 December?
items.a: Only two, and only until the afternoon: **Alexanderplatz until 14:00** and **Gendarmenmarkt until 18:00**. The Rotes Rathaus and the Humboldt Forum markets are closed on Christmas Eve.

items.q: How much is ice skating at the Rotes Rathaus Christmas market?
items.a: The rink around the Neptune Fountain costs **5 euros** to skate and **3 euros** for skate hire, in fixed sessions that cannot be booked ahead.
